title: Stephane Jourdan, Simon Rohrer & Pini Reznik - From Pipelines to Prompts: Surviving the Shift to AI
description:
The world of software development is shifting towards AI-native processes. Veteran developers now face the challenge of adapting from traditional cloud and DevOps methodologies to the emerging era of AI-driven technology. This transition is more than a technical pivot; it's an invitation to rethink foundational practices.

Stephane Jourdan, Simon Rohrer, and Pini Reznik bring invaluable insights to this panel, drawing from their extensive experience in cloud, DevOps, and DevSecOps. They have witnessed industry upheavals and emerged on the other side equipped to redefine software development once again. Their discussion reveals which cloud and DevOps habits remain relevant, and which assumptions are being overturned in the face of AI innovation.

What we cover:
• What habits from the cloud and DevOps eras still hold in AI-native development?
• How are foundational practices evolving with AI advancements?
• The role of DevSecOps in securing AI-driven pipelines.
• Identifying where AI hype surpasses reality in the current landscape.
• Reflections on the transition from traditional development to AI-native processes.
